checkpoints.description: [1/3] Make NeuralDeck pass the AIKit Phase 4 gates: align Anki tests with the no-proxy opener, resolve hygiene findings, and restore the README cold-start contract.

impact_assessment.why: AIKit is now attached; its check must pass before NeuralDeck can commit under the project workflow.
impact_assessment.benefits: Green test, hygiene and guidelines gates; documented cold-start and accurate test command.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: test expectations and README structure change; dependency: none added; concurrency: no runtime behavior change; state: .aikit memory added to the project repo.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep production behavior unchanged, patch tests only where mocks target the wrong callable, mark deliberate fallbacks inline, and run the full gate after each milestone.

checkpoints.description: [milestone 1/3] Tests, hygiene, guidelines and secrets gates all pass; Anki tests now patch the real no-proxy opener, deliberate fallbacks carry hygiene annotations, README documents the cold start and tree, and .aikit memory is ready to commit; checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets)
[milestone 1/3] 4/4 gates pass: no-proxy Anki mocks, documented UI fallbacks, runtime logs ignored, README cold-start tree, map regenerated, ADR-001; checklists: passed

[1/3] Add settings_io helpers with failing-first tests: env-aware config/log paths, crash-safe JSON read/write, and numeric setting coercion. [2/3] Wire the helpers into ui.py so config, session and log files no longer depend on CWD and Generate uses live, validated settings. [3/3] Record ADR-002, update README, and run the Phase 4 gate.

impact_assessment.why: README promises NEURALDECK_CONFIG and NEURALDECK_LOG but the code ignores them; config/session/log paths depend on the launch directory; config and session writes are non-atomic; invalid numeric settings can raise TclError and Generate silently uses stale context/concurrency values.
impact_assessment.benefits: Documented env overrides work, user data stays beside the app regardless of CWD, a crash cannot leave truncated JSON, and Generate applies the values visible in the Settings tab instead of the last saved config.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: config/session paths can move when env vars are set; dependency: none, stdlib only; concurrency: none, UI thread reads before worker starts; state: config.json and session_cache.json writes become temp+fsync+replace.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add pure-helper unit tests first, keep old defaults when env vars are unset, and verify the full project gate and test suite before delivery.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Delivered settings_io helpers and UI wiring: env-aware config/log paths, session beside config, atomic JSON writes, bounded numeric parsing, live Generate values. ADR-002 and README updated; codebase map regenerated. checklists: passed.

[review fixes] Frozen-aware application dir, unique temp files with in-process write lock and bounded replace retries, POSIX mode preservation, nested log dirs, 4-space config indentation, float/temperature parsing, session read warnings. Tests 115 pass + 1 POSIX skip; checklists: passed.

[review fixes 2] Accepted config saves report failures; corrupt config/session files are quarantined; stale writer and ReplaceFileW temp files are cleaned at startup; Windows replacement preserves ACLs/attributes via ReplaceFileW with WinError 2/1175/1176/1177 retries; personal config untracked with config.example.json. Tests 123 pass + 1 platform skip; checklists: passed.

[review fixes 3] Quarantine only malformed/wrong-shaped JSON; I/O-unreadable files stay and block saves. Config values normalized; invalid theme falls back. Session entries validated; structural failures quarantine and block overwrite. Added cross-process lock file, eliminated ReplaceFileW contention errors/leftovers. Docs/map synced. Tests 131 pass + 1 platform skip; checklists: passed.

[release gate] Session restore failures now block close-time cache overwrite; theme allowlist validated against ttkbootstrap 2.2.3 (cerculean); Windows metadata guarantee qualified to NTFS; GUI smoke and documented PyInstaller one-file smoke both passed; complete change set staged. Tests 131 pass + 1 platform skip; checklists: passed.

[release gate 2] Pinned runtime dependencies; exposed all 18 verified ttkbootstrap standard themes; added Clear All recovery for blocked session cache; documented persistent lock files and Windows copy; added requirements/example drift tests. GUI all-theme and config-save smoke passed; packaged one-file rebuilt from pinned deps and ran with log beside exe. Tests 132 pass + 1 platform skip; checklists: passed.

[release gate 3] Fully pinned transitive runtime dependencies; added explicit config recovery prompt that quarantines an unreadable config after consent; added automated theme-allowlist guard against installed ttkbootstrap; verified config/session recovery flows in GUI; rebuilt and ran final one-file executable from the pinned environment. Tests 132 pass + 2 prerequisite skips; checklists: passed.
